title: HARDENv2 / CGT-DAppSCAN: A Reproducible Bytecode Benchmark and Empirical Study of Smart-Contract Vulnerability Detectors
description:
Companion repository for A Reproducible Bytecode Benchmark and Empirical Study of Smart-Contract Vulnerability Detectors. It contains the CGT-DAppSCAN benchmark (2,186 Ethereum contracts, ten SWC weakness classes, fixed train/validation/test splits, heterogeneous CFG/DFG graph tensors, opcode and TF-IDF/expert-pattern feature tables, labels with per-(contract,label) assessment masks) together with the HARDENv2 model family and the full evaluation pipeline used in the paper.

The repository redistributes no upstream contract bytecode. CGT contributes on-chain bytecode (no license imposed by the CGT repository) and DAppSCAN ships no license, so contracts are referenced by identifier and a reconstruction script rebuilds the corpus bit-for-bit from the original sources. Source code is under the MIT License; derived data artifacts are under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA and DATA_PROVENANCE.md in the repository).
